replace: 18. Any other characteristic that could uniquely identify the individual. This includes the proper name of a specific organization or facility connected to the individual: a school, college or university (and its named buildings, dorms and teams), an employer or business, a hospital or clinic, a church, ward or congregation, an apartment complex, a sports team or club. Replace each with "[REDACTED: ORGANIZATION]". A generic reference without a proper name ("my school", "the hospital", "work", "my ward") is not an identifier and must be left as written
